name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Canonical Work Order
purpose: Operational TODO, dependency order and project orientation for maintaining, simplifying, validating and expanding the atlas. This file is intended to be read by future repository scans before new work begins.

project_introduction.mission: Map Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life, Potatoism, and the wider field of people, dwellers, dogs, cult and culture, places, institutions, ideas, events, symbols and systems that become meaningful in relation to them.
project_introduction.central_difficulty: Tim Dooley is highly relational. A useful map therefore cannot be reduced to a biography or isolated list of properties; it must map the relationships through which the subject becomes legible.
project_introduction.working_hypothesis: The Potato of Life is treated as a structural object whose attributed properties may make it useful for holding or comparing matter and spirit, inside and outside, root and fruit, boundary and interface, scale and dimension. The project investigates geometry, scale invariants, dimensions, relationships, transformations and recurring structures without assuming in advance what they prove.
project_introduction.goal: Build a navigable repository in which the highest-value information about Tim Dooley, the Potato, Potatoism and everything related can be located from multiple directions, while preserving the distinction between evidence, history, calculation, hypothesis, metaphor and project-defined interpretation.
project_introduction.method: Map first; connect second; interpret third. Let recurring structure generate hypotheses rather than silently turning symbolic patterns into empirical facts.

core_questions: What is Tim Dooley in the project's different senses?
What is the Potato of Life and what properties are attributed to it?
What is Potatoism and how has its vocabulary and architecture developed?
What is the Door and how does it relate to the Potato, Son, Father, Axis and Tree structures?
Which dimensions, scales, symmetries, invariants and transformations recur?
Which people, dwellers, dogs, groups, cultures, institutions, places, objects, texts and events are related to the central map?
Which relationships are observed or sourced, which are historical, which are calculated, and which are interpretive or hypothetical?
What structure becomes visible when the map is sufficiently connected?
core_rule: Do not expand a broken or duplicated layer. Audit first, simplify second, validate third, then add sourced data and relationships.
working_loop: read this project orientation and workflow
establish canonical owners and remove unnecessary paths
separate observed, calculated, estimated, historical, scenario and interpretive material
update views and manifests from canonical data
only then move to the next expansion area

gates.name: Repository snapshot
gates.rule: Before changing anything, inspect the current tree, manifests, routes, schemas, data counts and recent changes.

gates.name: Bug gate
gates.rule: Broken JSON, broken links, JavaScript errors, missing files, invalid references and failing routes take priority over enrichment.

gates.name: Duplication gate
gates.rule: Before creating a dataset, determine whether the information already has a canonical home. Merge, redirect or retire unnecessary duplicates.

gates.name: Architecture gate
gates.rule: Every dataset must have one owner, a defined purpose, a stable schema and a known consumer.

gates.name: Evidence gate
gates.rule: Empirical claims require source, indicator or claim type, value where applicable, reference period, publication/retrieval information and provenance.

gates.name: Identity gate
gates.rule: Every entity and relationship must resolve to canonical IDs; aliases are not duplicate entities.

gates.name: Validation gate
gates.rule: Run structural, semantic, reference, duplicate and completeness checks before publishing counts or declaring progress.

gates.name: View gate
gates.rule: Website pages are views over canonical data. Do not create page-specific shadow databases unless there is a documented reason.

gates.name: Release gate
gates.rule: Update manifests and counts only after the underlying data and integrity checks pass. Never use file existence as evidence of enrichment.

phases.name: Full repository audit
tasks: find stale counts and false completeness claims
find unused files and unreachable routes
record all bugs before adding new layers

phases.name: Fix bugs and broken paths
tasks: fix API failures and fallback behavior
make core pages render real content

phases.name: Simplify and consolidate
tasks: choose one canonical owner for each dataset
retire obsolete files only after consumers migrate
replace repeated page-specific data with canonical references
prefer one atlas with many views over many competing mini-atlases

phases.name: Lock the canonical data model
tasks: define aliases and canonical identity rules

phases.name: Make provenance universal
tasks: link every empirical relationship to evidence
record source dates and retrieval dates
distinguish observed from estimated and derived

phases.name: Build the real country layer
tasks: load trade and external relationship observations
stop calling a country enriched until validated evidence exists

phases.name: Build religion and belief as a real layer
tasks: keep Potatoism as project-defined contemporary material rather than empirical demographic fact

phases.name: Build the historical event layer
tasks: connect causes, participants and consequences with sources

phases.name: Expand philosophy, mythology and Potatoism
tasks: Tree of Life / Tree of Strife
Axis / North / Ladder / Door / Son / Father architecture
map dwellers, dogs, cult, culture and other project-relevant entities
clearly mark interpretive and project-defined material

phases.name: Add derived analysis
tasks: record inputs and formulas for every calculation

phases.name: Add scenario and policy layers
tasks: keep hypothetical material separate from observations

phases.name: Simplify the interface around the finished data model
Final audit before every declared milestone
tasks: only then declare the milestone complete

priority_rule: Critical gates and bugs outrank new data. Structural simplification outranks enrichment. Evidence-backed core data outranks decorative expansion. New layers are added only when their canonical owner, evidence model, relationships and consumer are clear.
expansion_rule: Before adding a new file, ask whether an existing canonical dataset can hold the information. If yes, extend it rather than creating another parallel dataset.
definition_of_done: A phase is done only when its data exists, its consumers work, its references resolve, its provenance is adequate, its duplicates are controlled, its manifest is accurate and the integrity checker passes.
